description: Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha - Missing List of the Roads and Thoroughfares of the Ibbagamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with the declaration of roads and thoroughfares as property owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Ibbagamuwa local government authority. It includes detailed schedules of specific roads with their coordinates, lengths, and widths, and addresses land ownership claims and legal procedures related to these properties. This falls under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions and ownership declarations by a local government body.
